threshold: Positive same-Object median driver saving strictly greater than both full within-Object baseline and candidate repeat ranges, fixed in scope.md before product edits.
measurementUnits: Two persisted Objects per framework/cell; three cold and six warm samples per candidate per Object; six cold and twelve warm samples across the identical baseline labels.
decision: No demonstrated driver-latency gain; no product PRs. Negative and inconclusive patches remain evidence only.
piLimit: Same history/sample positions in the interleaved pi Object, a different namespace. Differences are descriptive point estimates, not supported gains; no sub-spread difference is claimed.
